exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) status based on 75-g 2-hour glucose tolerance test (GTT) results
cohort: 9,835 women who underwent GDM testing and delivered a live singleton neonate
finding: Women with GDM-2 experienced significantly more adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to women without GDM, while GDM-1 was only associated with higher birth weight and risk of large for gestational age.
birth_weight: Included in the study but specific values not provided
